basis: The UNHCR asylum-applications panel is distributed through HDX (OCHA) under a CC BY 3.0 IGO licence recorded on the dataset page ('This dataset is: licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 IGO license', dataset 74cdbe77-0a0b-441b-9535-bacc263be2a8, read at discovery 2026-10-23 and re-checked with each fetch). CC BY 3.0 IGO permits any use, redistribution and adaptation with attribution, and the IGO port adds the standard protection that it grants no endorsement or sponsorship. Class A (attribution-only open licence permitting redistribution and derivatives), so the standing defaults apply: our code and documentation are MIT, our rights in the derived compilation are dedicated CC0-1.0, and the source's own terms are preserved, never relicensed.

compilation.scope: Our contribution - the corridor-year eligibility frame, the derived doubled label, the published-year feature derivations, the temporal partition, and the packaging - is dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0. The dedication covers only our contribution: the underlying asylum-applications statistics keep their own designation and remain subject to UNHCR's CC BY 3.0 IGO terms, whose attribution condition carries through to every copy of the derived data. Nothing here relicenses the source or presents CC0 as the source's terms.
